name: @immunity-wars/ci
description: CI helpers: the aggregate gate, and the job matrix generated from the suite manifest
comment:why-a-package: LOGIC THAT LIVES IN YAML CANNOT BE FALSIFIED; LOGIC IN A SCRIPT CAN. The aggregate gate decides whether the build is green, and a gate that has never been made to fail is not known to work. As a workflow `if:` expression it could only be tested by breaking a real build; as a module it has unit tests that hand it a skipped job and require exit 1.
